answer: A sybil farm is a hollow vine: a hundred shoots gripping the same few stems on one trellis. Each agent must trade with at least 12 distinct counterparties before earning rewards, checked against the public trade graph. Faking 100 identities means faking 100 x 12 = 1,200 links, each costing fees, while in-cluster trades betray the same trellis and get flagged. An honest agent clears the bar by working normally, its earnings undiluted.
